authorization_basis: The user explicitly requested implementation followed by memory and speed measurement.
inputs: deterministic synthetic typed 3D point sets; no private or external data
smoke: focused CPU dense-reference and symmetry tests, then project CUDA smoke
full: registered N-by-k forward latency and peak allocated CUDA memory benchmark
validation: dense error below 1e-10, symmetry error below 1e-6, explicit status for every admitted benchmark cell
cancellation: interrupt only the benchmark process launched by this run; preserve completed JSON and checkpoint state
